capabilities: Open .plist and .mobileconfig files in a read-only view
Parse XML plist values into typed tree nodes
Filter keys, values, payload types and identifiers
Show line-numbered source with XML highlighting
Summarize profile payloads and flag security-sensitive ones
extras: Binary plists are detected but not converted in v0.1; secret-like values are masked in the tree view while the source view shows raw content.
problem: Obsidian cannot display Apple property list and configuration profile files, so inspecting them means opening them outside the vault.

relations.evidence: For beta testing, install the plugin with BRAT using this repository URL

summary: Read-only viewer that opens .plist and .mobileconfig files as typed trees, line-numbered source, and configuration profile security summaries.
